_comment: Font files that replace Excalidraw 0.18.1's own in what we serve (owner's rulings, Shrey 2026-10-13; features/licence-gate.clan). excalidraw-fonts.ts copies Excalidraw's dist/prod/fonts into the build under excalidraw-assets/ and puts these in place of `target`, checking each sha256; licences/fonts.toml pins the same hashes and the licence gate checks both agree. The woff2 files are lossless container conversions (fontTools 4.60.1 + brotli 1.1.0, TTFont(...).flavor = 'woff2') of the upstream TTFs named in `source`.

overrides.replaces: Liberation Sans 1.05 (Ascender, GPLv2 with a font exception)

overrides.source: https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code/releases/download/v2407.24/CascadiaCode-2407.24.zip (sha256 e67a68ee3386db63f48b9054bd196ea752bc6a4ebb4df35adce6733da50c8474), member ttf/static/CascadiaCode-Regular.ttf (sha256 c33ef522cdfeff99907fb54f3e97152bb18bfb9b56ec2fef4d4ceec51c8974a4); LICENSE from the v2407.24 tag
